benefits.name: Annual Electricity Concession
benefits.summary: A daily discount on your electricity bill, worth about $673 a year.
benefits.eligibility_text: Pensioner Concession Card (Centrelink or DVA), Health Care Card, ImmiCard (Bridging Visa E) or Tasmanian Concession Card; name on card must match the account holder; principal place of residence on a general domestic tariff.
benefits.how_to_claim: Contact your electricity retailer or send them the Annual Electricity Concession application form.
benefits.notes: Commonwealth Seniors Health Card not listed. Concessions.tas.gov.au master list still shows the older 176.866 cents/day rate.

benefits.name: Annual Electricity Concession (embedded networks)
benefits.summary: If your power comes through a caravan park, retirement village or similar embedded network, you can get the electricity concession as a yearly payment.
benefits.eligibility_text: Same eligibility as the Annual Electricity Concession but you are supplied through an embedded network.
benefits.how_to_claim: Apply through a Service Tasmania outlet or the Service Tasmania website.
benefits.notes: Embedded network rates for medical cooling/heating and life support are also paid annually.

benefits.name: Medical Cooling or Heating Concession
benefits.summary: A daily discount on your power bill if you or someone you live with has a medical condition made worse by heat or cold.
benefits.eligibility_text: Eligible for the Annual Electricity Concession; hold a PCC or HCC; you or a household member has a qualifying condition (e.g. MS, Parkinson's, lupus) certified by a GP or specialist; recertify every four years.
benefits.how_to_claim: Get the form from your retailer, Service Tasmania or SRO, have your doctor certify it, and send it to your retailer.

benefits.name: Life Support Concession
benefits.summary: A daily discount on your power bill if you or someone you live with uses an approved life support machine at home.
benefits.eligibility_text: Account holder requires, or lives with someone who requires, an approved life support system at the principal place of residence. No concession card needed.
benefits.value_text: From $50.01 a year (mains nebuliser) to $939.82 a year (phototherapy machine); oxygen concentrator $498.72 a year
benefits.how_to_claim: Have your doctor certify the life support application form and send it to your electricity retailer.
benefits.notes: Value depends on the device; highest single-device rate is $939.82 a year.

benefits.name: Heating Allowance
benefits.summary: A small yearly payment to help pensioners with low savings pay for heating.
benefits.eligibility_text: Means-tested pensioners holding an eligible concession card; cash assets under $1,750 (single) or $2,750 (couple); other conditions apply.
benefits.value_text: $56 a year, paid as two $28 payments
benefits.how_to_claim: Apply online or request a form by phone or email (heatingallowance@dpac.tas.gov.au).
benefits.notes: Page does not name exactly which cards qualify; master list shows HCC and PCC.

benefits.name: Energy Hardship Fund
benefits.provider: Tas Government (run by The Salvation Army)
benefits.summary: Help for Tasmanians struggling to pay their energy bills.
benefits.eligibility_text: Tasmanians in energy bill hardship; detailed criteria not stated in the budget release.
benefits.how_to_claim: Contact The Salvation Army.
benefits.notes: Budget release only ($450,000 funding); no individual amount or application page found.

benefits.name: Council Rates Remission for Pensioners
benefits.summary: Money off council rates on the home you live in.
benefits.eligibility_text: PCC, HCC, or DVA Gold Card (TPI or War Widow/Widower) issued on or before 1 July 2026; principal place of residence. CSHC alone does not qualify.
benefits.value_text: Lesser of 30% of your rates or $591 ($401 if you are a TasWater customer)
benefits.how_to_claim: Apply in person at your council by 31 March 2027, showing your card. Back-claims for one prior year allowed.
benefits.notes: $401 cap applies to TasWater clients because they also get the TasWater concession.

benefits.name: Water and Sewerage Concession
benefits.summary: Money off the TasWater access charges for water and sewerage.
benefits.eligibility_text: Eligible HCC, PCC or DVA Gold Card holders who are TasWater customers.
benefits.value_text: Up to $242.56 a year ($121.28 water, $121.28 sewerage)
benefits.how_to_claim: Contact TasWater.
benefits.notes: Covers access charges only, not usage. 2026-27 amount not confirmed; TasWater site failed to load.

benefits.name: Tasmanian Seniors Card
benefits.summary: A free card giving discounts at businesses and on some government fees for Tasmanians aged 60+.
benefits.eligibility_text: Aged 60 or over, live in Tasmania and work less than 20 hours a week.
benefits.how_to_claim: Apply online or at any Service Tasmania centre.
benefits.notes: Page does not state a fee.

benefits.name: Adult Bus and Ferry Concession Fares
benefits.summary: Half-price fares on Metro and other buses and the River Derwent ferry.
benefits.eligibility_text: An eligible concession card, or aged 70 and over, or DVA Gold Card printed War Widow, among others.
benefits.value_text: 50% off the full fare, plus a further 20% off with a smartcard (e.g. Greencard) or 10-trip ticket
benefits.how_to_claim: Show your eligible card when buying a ticket or registering a smartcard.
benefits.notes: Aged 70+ qualifies without a card. Master list shows Seniors Card as eligible; transport page wording is 'eligible concession card'.

benefits.name: Free Bus Travel for DVA TPI and EDA Pensioners
benefits.summary: Free bus and ferry travel for veterans on the TPI or EDA pension.
benefits.eligibility_text: DVA Veteran Gold Card printed TPI or EDA.
benefits.how_to_claim: Get a Greencard to use on Metro buses.

benefits.name: Vision Impaired Travel Pass
benefits.summary: Free bus and ferry travel for people who are legally blind, plus an attendant and guide dog.
benefits.eligibility_text: PCC with blind pension endorsement or ophthalmologist assessment.
benefits.value_text: Free travel for cardholder, attendant and guide dog
benefits.how_to_claim: Apply via Department of State Growth (transport.tas.gov.au).

benefits.name: Taxi Subsidy Program
benefits.summary: Half-price (or 60% off) taxi trips for people with a severe disability who cannot use buses.
benefits.eligibility_text: Transport Access Scheme member; 60% rate is for wheelchair-reliant members.
benefits.value_text: 50% off, up to $25 a trip; or 60% off, up to $30 a trip (wheelchair reliant)
benefits.how_to_claim: Apply to join the Transport Access Scheme via transport.tas.gov.au.
benefits.notes: Master list shows concession cards and a generic option; membership of the Transport Access Scheme is the key requirement.

benefits.name: Bass Strait Islands Age Pension Air Travel Subsidy
benefits.summary: Age pensioners on King or Flinders Island get half of one return mainland flight back each year.
benefits.eligibility_text: Age pensioner (PCC) living on a Bass Strait island.
benefits.value_text: 50% rebate on one return trip to mainland Tasmania per financial year
benefits.how_to_claim: Apply via transport.tas.gov.au.

benefits.name: SeaLink Bruny Island Ferry Concession
benefits.summary: Cheaper vehicle fares on the Bruny Island ferry.
benefits.eligibility_text: CSHC or PCC holder driving; show card at check-in.
benefits.how_to_claim: Show your card at check-in.

benefits.name: Spirit of Tasmania Pensioner Fares
benefits.summary: Discounted passenger fares on the Spirit of Tasmania.
benefits.eligibility_text: Pensioner Concession Card holders; subject to availability.
benefits.value_text: Discounted selected passenger fares (amount not stated)
benefits.how_to_claim: Book with Spirit of Tasmania and quote your card.

benefits.name: Motor Tax 40% Rebate
benefits.summary: 40% off the motor tax part of registration for one car.
benefits.eligibility_text: Eligible concession card holder; one non-business vehicle up to 4.5 tonnes.
benefits.how_to_claim: Contact the Vehicle Registration Unit or Service Tasmania.

benefits.name: Vehicle Registration Concession
benefits.summary: Discount on 12-month registration fees for one vehicle.
benefits.eligibility_text: HCC, PCC, DVA White or Gold Card, or Transport Access Scheme member; one vehicle.
benefits.value_text: Car $60.20 off; motorcycle $55.07 off a 12-month registration
benefits.how_to_claim: Contact the Vehicle Registration Unit or Service Tasmania.
benefits.notes: May overlap with the motor tax rebate; check whether the two are additive.

benefits.name: MAIB Third-Party Insurance Concession
benefits.summary: $58 off compulsory third-party insurance for one vehicle.
benefits.eligibility_text: HCC, PCC, DVA White Card or Transport Access Scheme member; one vehicle.
benefits.how_to_claim: Contact the Vehicle Registration Unit or Service Tasmania.

benefits.name: Free Driver Licence (65+) and Licence Concessions
benefits.summary: No licence fee once you are 65 (photo fee only); card holders under 65 also save.
benefits.eligibility_text: Aged 65+ pay no licence fee; under 65 holders of HCC, PCC, DVA White/Gold save on fees.
benefits.value_text: 65+: no licence fee, $12.64 photo fee; under 65 card holders save $13.09 to $63.58
benefits.how_to_claim: Renew at Service Tasmania.

benefits.name: Free Ambulance for Tasmanian Residents
benefits.summary: Tasmanians don't pay for ambulance services in most cases, including some interstate emergencies.
benefits.eligibility_text: Tasmanian residents; apply for a fee waiver with proof of Tasmanian address. MAIB, WorkCover etc. pay first where they apply.
benefits.how_to_claim: If you get a bill, apply for a waiver with a certified copy of proof of Tasmanian address.
benefits.notes: Interstate cover depends on reciprocal agreements and varies by state.

benefits.name: Adult Public Dental Service
benefits.summary: Subsidised emergency, general and denture care at public dental clinics.
benefits.eligibility_text: HCC or PCC holders; DVA Veteran Card holders meeting criteria.
benefits.value_text: Subsidised (fee not stated); waiting lists may apply
benefits.how_to_claim: Phone Oral Health Services Tasmania.
benefits.notes: DVA enquiries 1800 838 272.

benefits.name: Patient Travel Assistance Scheme (PTAS)
benefits.summary: Help with travel and accommodation costs when you must travel far for specialist treatment.
benefits.eligibility_text: Travel more than 75 km one way for specialist care not available locally (more than 50 km for cancer or dialysis). Concession card holders don't pay the patient contribution.
benefits.value_text: Travel and accommodation subsidy; patient contribution of $82.50 a trip (capped at $330 a year) waived for concession card holders
benefits.how_to_claim: Contact your regional PTAS office (South 6166 8225, North 6777 6249, North-West 6477 7734).
benefits.notes: Subsidy amounts are in the PTAS Patient Guidelines, not loaded.

benefits.name: Spectacle and Visual Aids Assistance
benefits.summary: Subsidised glasses and low vision aids.
benefits.eligibility_text: PCC or DVA Orange/White/Gold holders and others meeting criteria.
benefits.value_text: Glasses for adults; low vision aids up to $436.05 per item
benefits.how_to_claim: Phone the Spectacles Assistance Scheme.
benefits.notes: Exact glasses subsidy not stated.

benefits.name: TasEquip
benefits.summary: Free or cheap equipment like shower chairs, walkers and wheelchairs to help you live at home.
benefits.eligibility_text: HCC or PCC holders living at home who need equipment.
benefits.how_to_claim: Phone TasEquip.

benefits.name: Public Hospital Pharmaceuticals
benefits.summary: Medicines from Tasmanian public hospital pharmacies cost at most $7.70 per item.
benefits.eligibility_text: Eligible concession card holders.
benefits.how_to_claim: Show your card at the hospital pharmacy.
benefits.notes: Concession-rate pharmaceuticals usually follow the PBS co-payment; confirm current figure.

benefits.name: Lymphoedema Compression Garments
benefits.summary: Help paying for compression garments for lymphoedema.
benefits.eligibility_text: HCC, PCC or DVA card holders with lymphoedema.
benefits.how_to_claim: Contact your hospital physiotherapy department (RHH 6166 8634, LGH 6777 6216, NW 6493 6250).

benefits.name: Orthotic and Prosthetic Services
benefits.summary: Lower charges for orthotics and prosthetics.
benefits.eligibility_text: HCC or PCC holders with a GP or specialist referral.
benefits.how_to_claim: Ask your GP or specialist for a referral (South 6166 7377, North 6777 8562, NW 6493 6272).

benefits.name: CPAP Program
benefits.summary: CPAP equipment for sleep breathing disorders.
benefits.eligibility_text: HCC or PCC holders prescribed CPAP by a sleep specialist.
benefits.how_to_claim: Contact the program with a sleep specialist prescription.

benefits.name: Home Oxygen Program
benefits.summary: Oxygen supply at home for people who need it.
benefits.eligibility_text: Patients assessed by a specialist as needing home oxygen.
benefits.how_to_claim: Through your specialist.

benefits.name: Wig Assistance
benefits.summary: Help with the cost of a wig for cancer or alopecia patients.
benefits.eligibility_text: PCC or DVA card holders referred by a doctor.
benefits.how_to_claim: Doctor referral to the hospital (RHH 6166 8308, LGH 6777 6477, Devonport 6478 6119).

benefits.name: National Parks Pass Discount
benefits.summary: 20% off annual and two-year Tasmanian national parks passes.
benefits.eligibility_text: HCC, CSHC, Seniors Card, Companion Card or PCC holders.
benefits.how_to_claim: Buy online or phone Parks and Wildlife.
benefits.notes: Overland Track, Three Capes Track, Hastings, Mole Creek Caves and Highfield also give discounts to the same card holders.

benefits.name: Heritage Site Concessions (Port Arthur, Female Factory, Botanical Gardens)
benefits.summary: Cheaper entry at Port Arthur and the Cascades Female Factory, and cheaper Botanical Gardens tours.
benefits.eligibility_text: Same card holders as national parks passes.
benefits.value_text: Discounted entry; 10% off at the Botanical Gardens shop
benefits.how_to_claim: Show your card when booking.
benefits.notes: Phone is Port Arthur; Female Factory 1800 139 478; Botanical Gardens 6166 0451.

benefits.name: Inland Recreational Angling Licence Discount
benefits.summary: 20% off an inland fishing licence for Seniors Card holders.
benefits.eligibility_text: Seniors Card holders (20%); PCC holders also listed.
benefits.how_to_claim: Buy online with your card number.
benefits.notes: PCC discount level not stated.

benefits.name: Recreational Sea Fishing Licence Concession
benefits.provider: Department of Natural Resources and Environment
benefits.summary: Half-price application fee on recreational sea fishing licences.
benefits.eligibility_text: Seniors Card, PCC, DVA cards (as listed).
benefits.how_to_claim: Apply online or phone.

benefits.name: Hunting Licence Discount
benefits.provider: Department of Natural Resources and Environment
benefits.summary: 20% off deer, wallaby, duck and other hunting licences.
benefits.eligibility_text: HCC, CSHC, Seniors Card or PCC holders.
benefits.how_to_claim: Contact Wildlife Services.

benefits.name: Firearms Fees Concession
benefits.summary: 20% off firearms licence fees.
benefits.eligibility_text: HCC or PCC holders.
benefits.how_to_claim: Contact Firearms Services.

benefits.name: Land Tax Exemption for Pensioners Partly Using Home for Other Purposes
benefits.summary: Pensioners can stay exempt from land tax even if part of the home is used for something else.
benefits.eligibility_text: Pensioners whose principal residence is partly used for other purposes.
benefits.how_to_claim: Email the SRO (taxhelp@treasury.tas.gov.au).
benefits.notes: Card requirement not specified; listed as generic for pensioners.

benefits.name: Free Will and Enduring Power of Attorney (Public Trustee)
benefits.summary: Free will or enduring power of attorney when you appoint the Public Trustee.
benefits.eligibility_text: Seniors Card or PCC holders, where the Public Trustee is appointed executor or attorney; one each per 12 months.
benefits.value_text: No charge for a standard appointment
benefits.how_to_claim: Phone the Public Trustee.

benefits.name: Free Library Computers and Internet
benefits.summary: Free computer and internet use at libraries and no overdue fines.
benefits.eligibility_text: Available to library members; PCC listed.
benefits.how_to_claim: Visit your local library.

benefits.name: Adult Education Course Concession
benefits.summary: Cheaper adult education courses.
benefits.eligibility_text: HCC, Seniors Card or PCC holders.
benefits.how_to_claim: Enrol and show your card.

benefits.name: No Interest Essential Loan (NILS)
benefits.summary: Interest-free loans up to $2,000 for essentials like fridges or car repairs.
benefits.eligibility_text: Card holders or gross income up to $60,000.
benefits.how_to_claim: Apply to NILS Tasmania.
benefits.notes: A loan, not a grant.

benefits.name: Veterans Wellbeing Voucher Program
benefits.summary: Two $100 vouchers for club or gym membership for veterans.
benefits.eligibility_text: Eligible veterans holding listed cards.
benefits.how_to_claim: Apply online or phone.
benefits.notes: Check whether the current round is open.

benefits.name: Private Rental Assistance
benefits.summary: Help with bond, rent in advance, rent arrears or moving costs.
benefits.eligibility_text: Low-income renters, including HCC holders.
benefits.value_text: Assistance with bond, rent or moving costs (amount not stated)
benefits.how_to_claim: Phone Housing Connect.

benefits.name: Social Housing
benefits.summary: Low-cost public or community housing for people on low incomes.
benefits.eligibility_text: Low income; financial assets under $35,000.
benefits.how_to_claim: Phone Housing Connect.
